name: weekly-certification-actions
title: Weekly Benefits Certification — submit
description: What the form can do with a completed Response: one action, `submit`. The renderer draws its button inside the form (labelled through the Locale, `$action.submit.label`) and, on activation, validates with the `on-submit` profile — every rule, not just the live ones. `blocking: block-on-error` stops there when any rule fails: the form opens its validation summary and focuses the first invalid answer, and nothing else happens. When every rule passes, `persistence: complete-response` marks the Response `completed` and the `hostEvent` effect raises `formspec-submit` to the page with the Response and its validation report. The page decides what happens next; here it shows the answers in a modal and submits nothing anywhere.
